whole_bytes_sha256: SHA-256 exact decoded full original bytes; byte_count is decoded count, base64 strictly canonical. Whole original schema bytes separately hashed and compared with actual installed original owner resource.
original_source_schema: Full schema resource plus original complete-record definition selected by the actual owner registration; no caller-selected validator, extracted schema or field projection.

source_commitments.producer_source_sha256: SHA-256 canonical JSON of complete WholeProducerSource, excluding every prospective producer/result/candidate field because none belongs to this source type. Preserve exact original raw bytes in their lossless carriers.
source_commitments.whole_native_original_source_sha256: Existing native original source canonical JSON codec over complete OriginalFinalDecisionSource.
source_commitments.whole_native_final_decision_sha256: Same codec over complete genuinely issued FinalDecisionResult; never a prospective result.
source_commitments.whole_standard_durable_read_sha256: Same explicit canonical source JSON over complete genuinely issued DurableStandardRead in its separate realm.
source_commitments.whole_current_goal_argument_sha256: Same explicit canonical source JSON over complete original CurrentGoalArgument in Goal realm.
source_commitments.installed_source_profile_sha256: Exact whole installed profile value digest, sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON without prefix/trailing LF.

event_candidate_sha256: SHA-256 pm.goal.certified_producer_source_json.v1 over all 25 producer-owned outer candidate fields, including complete payload and all required-present nulls. This full-candidate digest is distinct from Contracts_V0 producer_semantic_digest, whose exact original narrower field domain remains unchanged.
numeric_rule: Decode/validate integer and canonical codec domains losslessly, never IEEE754 truncation or inferred coercion. Preserve original spelling where its original raw-byte/time codec owns it.
acyclic_order: Genuine original assignment and actual owner inputs
Genuine original resolution/causal context and invocation issuance
Genuine original final Workflow decision and separately durable Standard read
Complete independently derived prospective producer candidate
event_identity_recipe: UNBOUND for current native-clock certified v3 until separately owned genuine complete recipe/admission exists. Current old v2 registry and Start recipe are not reused. The complete IdentityAdmissionSource carries actual original request, recipe, complete derivation sources and original owner decision when genuinely installed; strings/hashes alone cannot satisfy it.
